# `x4debug`

```text
usage: x4debug [-h] [--version] {triage,crosscheck,baseline} ...

Triage the engine's debug.txt, and compare it to what we predicted.

positional arguments:
  {triage,crosscheck,baseline}
    triage              bucket and attribute every [=ERROR=] line
    crosscheck          per-item diff of engine-skipped ops vs x4validate's prediction
    baseline            archive this log with a content fingerprint

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --version             show program's version number and exit
```

## `x4debug triage`

```text
options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
```

## `x4debug crosscheck`

```text
usage: x4debug crosscheck [-h] [--tier {a,b}] mod [log]

positional arguments:
  mod           mod path (use the DEPLOYED copy — load order matters)
  log

options:
  -h, --help    show this help message and exit
  --tier {a,b}
```

## `x4debug baseline`

```text
usage: x4debug baseline [-h] [--dest DEST] [log]

options:

  --dest DEST  archive dir (default: dev\_reports\debug)
```
